What we build

Explore real product demos, current project stages and work in development.

  • Khoj Learning — In development. Khoj Learning brings guided exploration and hands-on learning into one learning space.
  • Vimarsha — Testing. Turns any EPUB into a narrated audiobook ; figures surface in sync as you listen, voice notes drop straight onto the page, and an AI companion discusses the book with you using its own content.
  • Satya Social — In progress. A social-network project for India, exploring verified identity and human-authored participation.
  • LawyerBoss — Testing. A legal intake and drafting assistant that organizes case context and evidence for a lawyer to review.
  • InstantConfig — Testing. A compatibility-oriented product configurator, demonstrated through PC assembly.
  • DataMind — LaunchPad. An AI spreadsheet analyst for questions, charts and exploration, with local and hosted deployment options.
  • VR Real Estate Walkthrough — Testing. Immersive VR walkthroughs that let buyers tour a property or design long before construction begins ; so you sell the space before the first brick is laid.
  • QuantumExp — In development. An interactive quantum-computing lab with geometric-algebra explanations, amplitudes and circuit views.
  • NyayaLegal — In development. A legal-research workspace connecting questions, judgment sources and editable research notes.
  • TT Coach — In development. TT Coach is a review-assisted rally analysis project, connecting replay, reviewed bounce placement and evidence-linked practice feedback.
  • Kartar Media — In development. Kartar Media presents multilingual recorded news editions with editorial scripts, source links and clear AI-presenter disclosures.
  • CustomsIQ — In development. CustomsIQ is a logistics project in development.
